title: Explore Miami on a beautiful 45' Yacht
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set sail from Miami Beach on a stunning 45' yacht, offering a spacious interior and comfortable seating for an unforgettable day on the water. Enjoy the freedom to craft your own itinerary, whether you want to visit Haulover Sandbar, Raccoon Island, or Indian Creek Island, or simply cruise along Miami's picturesque waterways. A cooler with ice and water is provided, so just bring your favorite snacks and drinks to complete your adventure.

Highlight:
Explore Miami's waterways at your own pace on a luxury yacht
Choose your destinations for a personalized experience
Enjoy our 18' water floater and paddle board
Comfortable seating and a premium Bluetooth stereo system
Large cooler with ice and water included onboard
